entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's completely unwearable.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange it or get my money back immediately. This is unacceptable.
I understand. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Mike Smith, order number 458-1138. And you'd better not give me some runaround about a policy. I'll light you up on social media if you waste my time. Get me a manager if you can't handle this.
I appreciate you providing that, Mike. Let me take a look... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered about 85 days ago. Just one moment while I confirm our return eligibility.
85 days, 90 days, who cares? Your service is supposed to be premium. This shouldn't even be a question. Just process the exchange.

That won't be a problem at all, sir. I've confirmed that your jersey is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a return or an exchange for you right now. Which would you prefer?
Oh. For real? You're just going to do it? Fine. Then I want an exchange for the next size up.

Of course. I have initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. As soon as the carrier scans it, we will ship out the new size to you.
Alright. That's... actually what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mike. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
